newsitem.title: UK: LME copper loses more ground in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper loses more ground in late trading.

text.p: LME copper gave up more ground in late inter-office trading on Tuesday after finishing the afternoon kerb at its lows.
At 1800 GMT, three months metal was indicated at $1873/76 per tonne, down from a kerb close of $1,890.
One dealer said copper traded as low as $1,875.
After the weak close and the overall gloomy mood in the metals markets, more losses were expected, analysts said.
Next major support was pegged at the September 12 low of $1,850, chartists said.
Aluminium eased to $1,361/64 from a close of $1,367.50, but remained above a fresh 2-1/4 year low of $1,357 hit earlier.
The rest of the metals were little changed.
